# Pure Cycle Corporation to Participate in the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_4004c4cf55b9c9462f49e54c3b34531b/purecyclewater/news/2026-09-17_Pure_Cycle_Corporation_to_Participate_in_the_161.pdf) September 17, 2026 8:30am EDT


DENVER, Sept. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pure Cycle Corporation (Nasdaq Capital Market: PCYO) (“Pure Cycle”, “we”, “us” or “our”) announced today that Mark W. Harding, President and Chief Executive Officer, will participate in a webcast presentation and host one-on-one meetings with investors at the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference, taking place virtually on September 29-30, 2026.


"We are pleased to participate in the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference," commented Mr. Harding. "The virtual format allows us to reach a broad audience of institutional and individual investors and to detail our value proposition combining water and land development here in Colorado. Pure Cycle continues to drive shareholder value with development of our master planned community, Sky Ranch, while expanding Rangeview’s municipal water and wastewater system that serves Sky Ranch and other customers throughout our service area."


**Company Webcast**


Pure Cycle’s webcast presentation can be viewed beginning at 1:45 p.m. ET on Tuesday, September 29, 2026. The webcast can be accessed at[https://app.webinar.net/Xk3b9WmM5gE](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8dDr5a-c85XNX_qLEQ2dqGXMhGOmN1tej0kqoNcWbUNNO-KpQePHhd3AqmPrlLqxSEEr8SnaydWYV5ngMU6Vj1PRX2fQETEPesWJBcwTxo8vc-ygZ8HtV0dXONYxhld_65ctik-BnYnmbtluJn9_sg==) or by visiting the conference website at[https://lythampartners.com/fall2026/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8dDr5a-c85XNX_qLEQ2dqOKwOB3gVMFXNObcN8sJLdIhHTlgvu9ccawfmXC6z_akpvGis2hmJgGT5WZQ407SZUNQsrmCjtsY9bbZH2G7hRANr-GvAyhVHO4srDAhXM42i_1VYnSEP5uivkBYATmkVg==) . A replay will be available following the event.


**1x1 Meetings**


Management will participate in virtual one-on-one meetings with investors throughout the conference. To arrange a meeting, please contact Lytham Partners at[1x1@lythampartners.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=29PytHAj-gKMV8jWlrW6ie58WXFjkrZJ2NrT_FpE6y5xmXrTmP11wEzL3AKE5zPdzpUdOrf733N7t8LnatmiYs3EQKa8X70TgMIBxydrHlA=) or register for the event at[https://lythampartners.com/fall2026invreg/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8dDr5a-c85XNX_qLEQ2dqOKwOB3gVMFXNObcN8sJLdInuUyIu7KUpykmWT5gzPPHYShrl2uRa9Y5FPNJl_Yg2-WMwFJxvg_n0jtEFOojxE09xAFpSStAHxXvibh6P-GTdAjeNimytOPYJGNamoFAhg==) .


**Company Information**


Pure Cycle continues to strengthen its operations, build its balance sheet, and drive recurring revenues. We operate in three distinct business segments, each of which complements the others. At our core, we are a vertically integrated wholesale water and wastewater service provider. In 2017, we launched our land development segment, which develops master planned communities on land we own and to which we provide water and wastewater services. In 2021, we launched our newest line of business, the rental of single-family homes located at Sky Ranch, which provides long-term recurring revenues, furthers our land development operations, and adds more customers to our water resource segment.


Additional information, including our recent press releases and SEC filings, is available at[www.purecyclewater.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=VrhCf9gfYqyAhGzmXdW5m_ue0LFSdu4n0SpWv4o5YLgTnDzWsATxkO_Mvk4QFo7OhWujkvURkBWwgISTVm44jvKlKFdVZ-QKAWZcOZlUk8U=) , or you may contact our President, Mark W. Harding, or our CFO, Marc Spezialy, at 303-292-3456 or[info@purecyclewater.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=UcpK4MPDQQ_QPl3LnpoUv_-z4_aYzdieRslbHTalA17yP5cQe7StsHG9Tmp6ewqb7WptuiErMmkjnsEyktNzBgsc2WZ0HJz2Xi-4A_ZS_Wg=) .
